title: dangausakis.lt air-alert region polygon
description: Published BY bridges/vendors/dangausakis/dangausakis_bridge.py for each active alert region (one track per part of a multi-part region), JSON-only: an alert zone is not a detected object, so no SAPIENT/protobuf view exists. A cleared alert is re-published once as {uid, _delete: true}.

lat_deg.description: Centroid anchor for the zone's marker.

coordinates.description: One closed ring of [lon, lat], at most 150 vertices.

shape_color.description: Stroke/fill colour tak_layer applies to the polygon.

shape_style.description: Present on the fills drawn behind the district zones. "wash": DA-WASH-<oblast id> (an oblast with an active district alert, coloured by its worst district), a faint fill with a thin outline. "country": DA-COUNTRY-<code> (a standing country status the site draws, Belarus orange and Russia red), a stronger fill and outline so it reads at country scale.

alert_id.description: The alert or oblast id; COUNTRY:<code> for a standing country status.

stale_s.description: Seconds the layers keep this zone without a re-send (600). The bridge re-sends an unchanged zone only every DANGAUSAKIS_ZONE_REFRESH_S because TAK stores every event.
